Container.Name: clonarr

Branch.TagDescription: Development builds — may contain bugs or breaking changes

Container.Overview: TRaSH Guides sync tool for Radarr and Sonarr with a built-in web UI. Browse, customize, and sync Custom Formats, Quality Profiles, Scores, and Quality Sizes from TRaSH Guides to your Radarr and Sonarr instances. Features profile builder, scoring sandbox, auto-sync, and import/export support.
Container.Changes:
### 2026-06-06 - v3.1.0: New Custom Formats "In use" sub-tab that catalogues every CF on each Arr instance with Managed vs Unmanaged classification, per-CF drift detection, and one-click adopt for unmanaged CFs. The "+ Add to Arr" button can now push a CF straight into a sync rule profile in addition to the existing instance-only mode. Sortable In use columns (Name, Category, Used in, Status, Last sync). Sticky toolbars on Browse and In use so actions stay reachable while scrolling. Plus five fixes for v3.0.0-shipped bugs (dry-run ghost entries, Sonarr profile overview crash on duplicate suffixes, language CF link 404s, Sync Rules narrow-viewport overflow, CF name tooltip jumpiness). - v3.0.0: Ground-up UI redesign. Persistent sidebar nav (or top bar if you prefer), app-themed banner, dark and light themes. Custom Formats tab rebuilt with hierarchical Browse, inline condition pills, hover descriptions, clone, and a rewritten editor. Three auto-sync modes (Apply automatically, Just notify me, Wait before applying). Arr drift detection. Notes per sync rule. Sync rule clone across instances. Per-instance auto-sync pause. Scoring Sandbox state persists to disk. Browser back/forward works throughout. CIDR ranges in TRUSTED_PROXIES. Find unused Quality Profiles under Maintenance.
For full version history, see CHANGELOG.md on GitHub.
Container.Requires: Radarr or Sonarr instance with API access. See project page for setup instructions.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Configuration, profiles, sync history, and TRaSH Guides cache

Config.Name: TRUSTED_NETWORKS
Config.Description: Optional: lock Trusted Networks at host level. Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs (e.g. 192.168.86.0/24, 10.66.0.0/24). When set, the UI field becomes read-only and can only be changed by editing this template and restarting. Leave empty to configure via the Security panel in the web UI. Loopback is always trusted regardless.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: Optional: lock Trusted Proxies at host level. Comma-separated reverse-proxy IPs (e.g. 172.17.0.1). Only needed when Clonarr sits behind SWAG, Authelia, Traefik, etc. When set, the UI field becomes read-only. Leave empty for direct access.
